title: Self-improving generative foundation model for synthetic medical image generation and clinical applications

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Self-improving generative foundation model for synthetic medical image generation and clinical applications》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Clinician evaluations and rigorous objective measurements validate the high quality of MINIM's synthetic images.

evidence.text: Clinician evaluations and rigorous objective measurements validate the high quality of MINIM's synthetic images.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Self-improving generative foundation model for synthetic medical image generation and clinical applications》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Using a large retrospective simulation analysis, we demonstrate MINIM's clinical potential by accurately identifying targeted therapy-sensitive EGFR mutations using lung cancer computed tomography images, which could potentially lead to improved 5-year survival rates.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Although these results are promising, further validation and refinement in more diverse and prospective settings would greatly enhance the model's generalizability and robustness.

evidence.text: Using a large retrospective simulation analysis, we demonstrate MINIM's clinical potential by accurately identifying targeted therapy-sensitive EGFR mutations using lung cancer computed tomography images, which could potentially lead to improved 5-year survival rates.
Although these results are promising, further validation and refinement in more diverse and prospective settings would greatly enhance the model's generalizability and robustness.
